items.example: That's a blatant lie and you know it.
items.exampleTr: Bu apaçık bir yalan, sen de biliyorsun.
items.simple: A lie that is so clear, everyone can see it is not true.
dialogue: A: He said he was stuck in traffic.
B: That's a blatant lie. I saw him at the pub.
items.note: 'blatant' = utanmadan, göz göre göre; 'blatant rip-off' da olur.

items.example: 'My dog ate it' is a pretty flimsy excuse.
items.exampleTr: 'Köpeğim yedi' oldukça çürük bir bahane.
items.simple: A reason that is weak and nobody really believes.
dialogue: A: She said she couldn't come because of the rain.
B: Bit of a flimsy excuse, isn't it?
items.note: 'flimsy' aslında 'ince, dayanıksız' demek; argüman için de kullanılır.

items.tr: kısacık bir bakış, bir anlığına görme
items.example: I only caught a fleeting glimpse of him at the airport.
items.exampleTr: Havalimanında onu sadece bir anlığına gördüm.
items.simple: You see something for a very short moment, then it's gone.
dialogue: A: Did you see the bride?
B: Just a fleeting glimpse as she walked in.
items.note: Ünlü, manzara, geçen araba için; 'catch a fleeting glimpse' kalıbı.

items.example: Don't mention his ex, it's a bit of a sore point.
items.exampleTr: Eski sevgilisinden bahsetme, biraz hassas bir konu.
items.simple: A topic that makes someone upset, so you'd better not talk about it.
dialogue: A: How's his driving test going?
B: Shh, that's a sore point. He failed again.
items.note: 'a bit of a sore point' şeklinde yumuşatarak çok kullanılır.

items.example: Let's be honest, the result was a foregone conclusion.
items.exampleTr: Dürüst olalım, sonuç baştan belliydi.
items.simple: Everyone knew how it would end before it even started.
dialogue: A: Do you think Sarah will get the job?
B: It's a foregone conclusion. She's the boss's niece.
items.note: Maç, seçim, terfi için; 'It's not a foregone conclusion' = henüz belli değil.

items.example: She handled the angry client like a seasoned pro.
items.exampleTr: Kızgın müşteriyi işin kurdu gibi idare etti.
items.simple: Someone who has done a thing many times and is very good at it.
dialogue: A: Aren't you nervous about the speech?
B: Nah, I'm a seasoned pro at this by now.
items.note: Bazen esprili: 'You're a seasoned pro at moving house now'.

items.example: Getting my kids to eat vegetables is an uphill battle.
items.exampleTr: Çocuklarıma sebze yedirmek tam bir zorlu mücadele.
items.simple: Something very hard to do, like walking up a steep hill.
dialogue: A: How's the diet going?
B: It's an uphill battle with all the office biscuits.
items.note: 'an uphill struggle' da aynı anlamda.

items.example: It's an open secret that they're dating.
items.exampleTr: Çıktıkları herkesin bildiği bir sır.
items.simple: A secret that is not really secret, because everyone knows it.
dialogue: A: Is Mike really leaving?
B: Oh, it's an open secret. He's already cleared his desk.
items.note: Ofis dedikodusunda çok kullanılır.

items.example: Quitting was just a knee-jerk reaction to a bad day.
items.exampleTr: İstifa etmek kötü bir güne verilmiş düşüncesiz bir tepkiydi.
items.simple: Doing something fast without thinking, like when a doctor taps your knee.
dialogue: A: I'm going to delete all my social media.
B: Isn't that a knee-jerk reaction to one bad comment?
items.note: Genelde eleştiri: aceleci, düşünülmemiş karar.

items.example: He made a half-hearted attempt to tidy his room.
items.exampleTr: Odasını toplamak için baştan savma bir girişimde bulundu.
items.simple: Trying to do something, but not really trying hard.
dialogue: A: Did he apologise?
B: Sort of. It was a half-hearted attempt at best.
items.note: 'make a half-hearted attempt' kalıbı; özür için de: 'a half-hearted apology'.

items.example: I've got a sneaking suspicion he's forgotten my birthday.
items.exampleTr: İçimden bir ses doğum günümü unuttuğunu söylüyor.
items.simple: A small feeling inside that something is true, but you're not sure.
dialogue: A: Why are you smiling?
B: I have a sneaking suspicion they're planning a surprise.
items.note: Hep 'have a sneaking suspicion that...' kalıbında.

items.example: The night staff always get a raw deal on holidays.
items.exampleTr: Bayramlarda gece vardiyası hep haksızlığa uğruyor.
items.simple: When you are treated unfairly and get less than others.
dialogue: A: They gave her the smallest office again.
B: She always gets a raw deal.
items.note: 'get a raw deal' kalıbıyla, gayriresmî.

items.example: Bringing up his divorce was a cheap shot.
items.exampleTr: Boşanmasını gündeme getirmek alçakçaydı.
items.simple: A mean thing you say to hurt someone, in an unfair way.
dialogue: A: I only said he's going bald.
B: Come on, that was a cheap shot.
items.note: Tartışmada haksız, kişisel saldırı için.

items.example: It was painfully obvious that he hadn't read the report.
items.exampleTr: Raporu okumadığı apaçık belliydi.
items.simple: So easy to see that it is almost embarrassing.
dialogue: A: Do you think she likes him?
B: It's painfully obvious. She laughs at all his jokes.
items.note: Genelde utanç verici bir durum için.

items.example: Finishing it by Friday is wildly optimistic.
items.exampleTr: Cumaya kadar bitirmek fazlasıyla iyimser bir beklenti.
items.simple: Hoping for something good that is very unlikely to happen.
dialogue: A: I reckon the builders will be done in a week.
B: That sounds wildly optimistic to me.
items.note: Tahmin, plan, bütçe eleştirirken nazik ama net.

items.example: The new manager is refreshingly honest about the problems.
items.exampleTr: Yeni müdür sorunlar konusunda insanın içini açacak kadar dürüst.
items.simple: Honest in a nice, surprising way, when most people aren't.
dialogue: A: The estate agent said the flat was tiny.
B: Wow, that's refreshingly honest for an estate agent.
items.note: Övgü; 'refreshingly normal/direct' da denir.

items.example: She's fiercely loyal to her friends.
items.exampleTr: Arkadaşlarına sonuna kadar sadıktır.
items.simple: Someone who always stands by you and will fight for you.
dialogue: A: Will Sam tell anyone?
B: No way. He's fiercely loyal.
items.note: Kişi, hayran, köpek için; güçlü bir övgü.

items.example: Without my phone, I'd be hopelessly lost in this city.
items.exampleTr: Telefonum olmasa bu şehirde fena halde kaybolurdum.
items.simple: So lost you have no idea where you are or what to do.
dialogue: A: Did you understand the new software?
B: No, I'm hopelessly lost.
items.note: Yer için ama mecazen de: 'hopelessly lost in maths'.

items.example: Your face looks vaguely familiar. Have we met?
items.exampleTr: Yüzünüz hafiften tanıdık geliyor. Tanışıyor muyuz?
items.simple: You think you've seen or heard it before, but you're not sure.
dialogue: A: Do you know this song?
B: It sounds vaguely familiar.
items.note: Yüz, isim, şarkı için; 'rings a bell' ile yakın.

items.example: The film was mildly amusing, but nothing special.
items.exampleTr: Film hafif komikti ama özel bir şey değildi.
items.simple: A little bit funny, but it didn't make you really laugh.
dialogue: A: Did you like his stand-up show?
B: It was mildly amusing, I suppose.
items.note: Çoğu zaman kibar bir küçümseme; İngiliz soğukluğu.

items.example: Coffee at the airport is ridiculously expensive.
items.exampleTr: Havalimanında kahve saçma derecede pahalı.
items.simple: Costs so much money that it seems silly.
dialogue: A: Shall we eat here?
B: No, it's ridiculously expensive.
items.note: Konuşmada çok yaygın; 'stupidly expensive' de denir.

items.example: I turned up to the exam woefully unprepared.
items.exampleTr: Sınava fena halde hazırlıksız gittim.
items.simple: Not ready at all, in a sad and worrying way.
dialogue: A: Did you bring a map, water, anything?
B: No. I'm woefully unprepared for this hike.
items.note: 'woefully' = acınacak derecede; esprili de kullanılır.

items.example: I'm perfectly capable of making my own dinner, thanks.
items.exampleTr: Kendi yemeğimi gayet yapabilirim, sağ ol.
items.simple: You can do it fine by yourself, you don't need help.
dialogue: A: Do you want me to park the car for you?
B: I'm perfectly capable of parking, thank you.
items.note: Hafif alıngan tonda: 'Ben yaparım, karışma.'

items.example: That recipe is notoriously difficult to get right.
items.exampleTr: O tarif doğru yapması zor olmasıyla meşhurdur.
items.simple: Everyone knows it is very hard to do.
dialogue: A: I'm going to try to get a table at that restaurant.
B: Good luck, it's notoriously difficult.
items.note: 'notoriously' kötü ünü anlatır: 'notoriously late, notoriously unreliable'.

items.example: The office was eerily quiet on Christmas Eve.
items.exampleTr: Noel arifesinde ofis ürkütücü derecede sessizdi.
items.simple: So quiet that it feels strange and a bit scary.
dialogue: A: Where are the kids?
B: No idea. It's eerily quiet upstairs.
items.note: 'eerily similar' = tüyler ürpertecek kadar benzer.

items.example: Ignoring her like that was downright rude.
items.exampleTr: Onu öyle görmezden gelmek düpedüz kabalıktı.
items.simple: Not just a bit rude, but really, clearly rude.
dialogue: A: He didn't even say thank you.
B: That's downright rude.
items.note: 'downright' olumsuz sıfatları güçlendirir: 'downright dangerous'.
